description: Browse and filter eval records by status, domain, task_type, or tag. Returns a compact summary per record (id, status, task_type, domain, tags, timestamps), not the full records — call evals_get_record for a single record in full. Results are newest-first and the response discloses when the limit truncated the set.

domain.description: Filter to records whose metadata.domain equals this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of summaries to return.

status.description: Filter to draft-only or submitted-only records.

tag.description: Filter to records carrying this tag.

task_type.description: Filter to records of this task type.

name: evals_list_records

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no records matched the filter.

items.description: A compact record summary (id, status, task_type, domain, tags, timestamps).

status.description: The record lifecycle state: draft (mutable) or submitted (frozen).

submitted_at.description: Submit time; present only for submitted records.

task_type.description: The eval task type. numeric: a number/expression answer; exact_answer: a normalized string; set_answer: an unordered/ordered set; mcq: a multiple-choice selection (requires choices); regex_answer: a pattern match; json_answer: a structured value; free_response: rubric-graded prose (requires an llm_rubric grader).

totalCount.description: Total records matching the filter before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when the limit truncated the matching set.

title: evals-mcp-server: list records
